units.source_text: 我们平时七点钟之前起床，因为学校大多是八点钟上课，不然就会迟到，所以女佣会在六点钟起床。

en.t: We usually got up before seven, because school generally began at eight and otherwise we would be late, so the maid would get up at six.

units.source_text: 但是，那天我去叫女佣起来时，还不到六点钟。

en.t: But that day, when I went to wake the maid, it was still before six.

units.source_text: 这时夫人提醒我今天是星期日，夫人是听见我的脚步声醒来的。

en.t: Then the lady reminded me that it was Sunday; she had awakened when she heard my footsteps.

units.source_text: 我对夫人说：‘您要是醒了的话，请到我的房间里来一下。’

en.t: I said to her, If you are awake, please come to my room for a moment.

units.source_text: 夫人在睡衣外面披了一件平时穿的外褂，跟在我后面，来到我的房间。

en.t: The lady put an everyday haori over her nightclothes, followed behind me, and came to my room.

units.source_text: 我一进屋就立刻拉上了刚才还开着的隔扇，然后小声告诉夫人：‘出大事了。’

en.t: As soon as I entered the room, I immediately closed the sliding partition that had just been open, and then told the lady in a low voice, Something terrible has happened.
The lady asked, What has happened?

units.source_text: 我抬起下巴朝隔壁指了指，说：‘您可得有个心理准备。’

en.t: I lifted my chin and gestured toward the next room, saying, You must prepare yourself.
The lady's face turned deathly pale.
Madam, K has killed himself, I said again.

units.source_text: 夫人吓得瑟缩着，盯着我的脸，半天没有说话。

en.t: The lady shrank back in fright and stared at my face, saying nothing for a long while.

units.source_text: 我突然匍匐在夫人面前，低下头向她谢罪：‘对不起，都是我不好。

en.t: I suddenly prostrated myself before the lady, lowered my head, and apologized to her: I am sorry; it is all my fault.

units.source_text: 我对不起您，也对不起小姐。’

en.t: I have wronged you, and I have wronged your daughter as well.

units.source_text: 在见到夫人之前，我根本没想这样说的，但是，一见到夫人，便情不自禁地脱口而出。

en.t: Before seeing the lady, I had never meant to say such a thing, but the moment I saw her, the words escaped me against my will.

units.source_text: 你这样想好了，不能够向K谢罪的我，只能这样向夫人和小姐道歉了。

en.t: Please think of it this way: unable to apologize to K, I could only apologize like this to the lady and her daughter.

units.source_text: 就是说，本真的我，骗过了平时清醒时的我，迷迷糊糊地作出了忏悔。

en.t: In other words, my true self slipped past my usually sober self and, half dazed, made a confession.

units.source_text: 好在夫人并没有理解得那么深，对我来说真是幸运。

en.t: Fortunately, the lady did not understand it so deeply, and that was truly lucky for me.

units.source_text: 她面色苍白，却以安慰的口吻说：‘这种事任凭谁也想不到的，没办法。’

en.t: Her face was pale, yet she said in a comforting tone, No one could have imagined such a thing; there is nothing to be done.

units.source_text: 然而夫人的表情僵硬，仿佛惊慌和恐怖雕塑了她的面部肌肉一般。

en.t: Yet the lady's expression was rigid, as if panic and terror had carved themselves into the muscles of her face.
